remarks: Freshened up and ready for the next tenant. Spacious 2nd floor 2 bedroom unit in Linden House. Heat, water & cooking gas included in rent. Large rooms with hardwood flooring. Close proximity to bus line, downtown Stamford, shopping, dining and train. This unit is ready for you now! Sorry no pets and excellent credit and references are a must.
